arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import glom.core as core

# Test Check repr edge cases
print('Empty Check:', repr(core.Check()))
print('Check with spec only:', repr(core.Check(spec=core.T)))
print('Check with type:', repr(core.Check(type=int)))
print('Check with multiple types:', repr(core.Check(type=(int, str))))
print('Check with instance_of:', repr(core.Check(instance_of=Exception)))
print('Check with equal_to:', repr(core.Check(equal_to=42)))
print('Check with one_of:', repr(core.Check(one_of=[1, 2, 3])))
print('Check with default:', repr(core.Check(default='N/A')))
print('Check with validate:', repr(core.Check(validate=lambda x: True)))
print('Check with all args:', repr(core.Check(spec=core.T['a'], type=int, instance_of=Exception, equal_to=0, default=None)))
"
